🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector signals (Tech, Industrials, Materials positive while Healthcare, Utilities, Real Estate lag) and narrow leadership concentration in Tech (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 Top performers Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +15.37% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND; Sector breadth: Tech 16/24 positive. Industrials strong: ETN (1W: +23.60% | 1M: +13.04%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials 10/15 positive. Materials showing strength: FCX (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +17.24%) ABOVE TREND, DD (sentiment) — Materials 8/11 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples weak: MO (1W: -8.65% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +1.70%) CORRECTION; Consumer Stpl 3/14 positive. Utilities weak: (representative) Utilities 2/10 positive. Real Estate weak: VTR (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -1.64%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: +1.71%) CORRECTION; Real Estate 3/10 positive.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +28.80% | 1M: +17.91%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +23.60% | 1M: +13.04%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +23.42% | 1M: -8.45%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MO (1W: -8.65% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -8.04% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION, EOG (1W: -8.02% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION, F (1W: -7.53% | 1M: +4.20%) CORRECTION, AMT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: +1.71%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Real Estate and defensive staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +28.80%), MSFT (1W: +24.82%), ETN (1W: +23.60%), INTC (1W: +23.42%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +22.63%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple large-cap names show 1W vs 1M mismatch (INTC, AMAT, LRCX, GOOGL, META, AAPL) — tactical moves, watch for trend confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but leading; rotation inside Tech with big winners and notable reversals. Examples: MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +15.37% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -8.04% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION — Tech breadth: 16/24 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Generally constructive and selective. JPM (1W: +4.22% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +7.49%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.64%) CORRECTION — Financials breadth: 11/20 positive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive names under pressure despite some strong news; breadth weak. JNJ (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND — Healthcare breadth: 6/17 positive.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to leaders in Technology and Industrials while monitoring the narrow concentration in Tech leadership; reduce exposure to lagging Real Estate and defensive Staples. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech top performance but only 6/11 sectors positive; treat recent rallies as tactical until divergence resolves.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +28.80% | 1M: +17.91%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +20.30% | 1M: +10.84%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -8.04% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND, MO (1W: -8.65% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (Tech 16/24 positive) and Industrials (10/15 positive) for leadership signals. BEARISH: Healthcare (6/17 positive) and Consumer Staples (3/14 positive) for downside risk and earnings/news sensitivity.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
MSFT near continuation zone — monitor for follow-through (MSFT (1W: +24.82% | 1M: +25.36%) ABOVE TREND). AAPL support test critical (AAPL (1W: -8.04% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION). NVDA pivot for momentum resumption (NVDA (1W: +15.37% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND). JPM breakout sustain would confirm Financials resilience (JPM (1W: +4.22% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND).

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+65): Nvidia news tied to SpaceX noted and stock ABOVE TREND (NVDA (1W: +15.37% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND) — sentiment confirming price. LLY (+85): Q2 beat/raise but LLY is BELOW TREND (LLY (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND) — bullish news but price diverging (distribution risk). MRK (+80): positive headline; monitor MRK price action relative to sector weakness.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
KHC (-70): large charge and KHC showing CORRECTION-like action (KHC (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +1.70%) CORRECTION) — news and price aligned. PANW (-45): China cybersecurity review flagged but PANW is trading ABOVE TREND (PANW (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +7.60%) ABOVE TREND) — negative news vs rising price (divergence). INTU (-50): downgrade noted; watch for spillover into growth/software names.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration. MSFT ABOVE TREND, PLTR ABOVE TREND and ETN ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large-cap tech and select reversals (AAPL CORRECTION) plus bullish Healthcare headlines (LLY) not yet reflected in price.
